_comment: Branch junctions where a line direction has separate platforms per branch. tools/junctions.py splits each listed station's platforms of `line` into one per (direction, branch). A service's run in a direction uses the entry of that direction whose `via` station it also calls at. `number` is the real platform number, `module` names the platform module (entries with the same module share an island; the pairing of platforms into islands is this simulator's choice, the sources give numbers and branches only). Directions without an entry stay one shared platform (see `shared`). Sources: live TfL arrivals (tools/fetch_platform_dests.py, data/platform_destinations.json: 'Camden Town northbound 1 = Edgware, 3 = High Barnet; southbound 2 = via Charing Cross, 4 = via Bank'; Euston 1/2 = Charing Cross branch, 3/6 = Bank branch; Kennington northbound 1 = via Charing Cross, 3 = via Bank, southbound 2 = via Charing Cross) and the Wikipedia station articles (Finchley Central: platform 2 mainly High Barnet trains, platform 1 Mill Hill East and terminating trains, platform 3 southbound). Stations where the live data show shared or mixed platforms (Acton Town, Earl's Court, Turnham Green, Leytonstone, Woodford, North Acton, Harrow-on-the-Hill, Moor Park, Chalfont & Latimer, Rayners Lane) are deliberately not split.
